items.claim: Jackson McVey is 6'4 and a big dude for his weight class.
items.quote: Jackson McVey is pretty big dude for this weight class. He's 6'4.

items.claim: Jackson McVey uses deep kicks to manage range and has a busy jab.
items.quote: He'll use deep kicks to try to manage that range. He's got a busy jab.

items.claim: Wesley Schultz was 47-0 in high school wrestling and an all-American in junior college and D3.
items.quote: Before that, he was 47-0 in high school. Then he went to a junior college where he was all-American. Then he went to a D3 school to wrestle and he was all-American there as well.

items.claim: Wesley Schultz has good top control, stays busy, and chains wrestling takedowns well.
items.quote: he's got good top control. He stays busy. Does a nice job shooting a takedown, then transition to another until he eventually gets it to the ground.

items.claim: Wesley Schultz's striking hands are almost non-existent.
items.quote: the hands aren't quite there. They're almost non-existent whatsoever.
